English: Grain Store
A simple, makeshift storage of grain sacks under canvas or lean-tos, offering minimal protection but crucial for the first harvests.
Wooden Granary
Crude wooden huts raised on stones, keeping grain away from damp and vermin, improving supply and boosting morale.
Raised Granary
Sturdier, stilted structures with thatched roofs, these granaries are protected from pests and weather, enhancing both food reserves and security.
Stone Granary
Solid stone granaries, sealed against the elements and thieves. Provides significant food security for the castle and supports larger garrisons.
Guarded Granary
Well-fortified stone storehouses with armed guards, ensuring food stocks remain secure even during siege.
Ventilated Storehouse
Granaries with improved stonework and venting, reducing spoilage and supporting a sustained levy presence.
Expanded Storehouse
A sprawling network of granaries, supporting both the castle and the surrounding settlements, with multiple reinforced storage rooms and strong oversight.
Silo Complex
A sophisticated array of stone silos with advanced ventilation and security, enabling the castle to weather long sieges and expand its influence.
Secured Granary
The castles grain reserves are protected by walls, heavy doors, and vigilant patrols, ensuring supplies for the largest armies and most trying times.
Grand Granary
A monumental granary complex, symbolizing the wealth and might of the realm. Ensures unmatched supply, prosperity, and fortitude.
